prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Production texture cutout for a realistic low-poly historical straw sleeping mat.
Input is a STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY: the old tan natural straw cords and broken grass fibres in the supplied approved reference sheet.
Generate ONE SINGLE small frayed tassel made of dried cattail/rice-straw cord fibres, isolated on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background. This is a texture source for an alpha-cutout game mesh, not a whole rope or mat.
Composition: centered VERTICAL little tuft, narrow joined ROOT at the BOTTOM center, many fine broken grass strands fanning UPWARD and slightly outward. Approximately 20–30 distinct very thin plant-fibre strips of uneven lengths, longer middle fibres, sparse wispy split tips, a few bent strands crossing. Physical interpretation: a tuft only about 20 mm long and 10–12 mm wide, with a 2 mm wide root. Keep the full tuft and loose tips inside the frame. No big knot or solid lump, no horizontal cord, no bundle cylinder.
Material and colour: pale sun-bleached straw tan, warm light grey-brown weathering and darker dusty fibres in the root, fine longitudinal grain and brittle flattened grass tips. Match the reference's rough dry natural straw and restrained irregularity. Photographic macro realism, soft uniform neutral cross-polarized light, no directional glow or strong dark shadows.
Silhouette must contain abundant fine TRANSPARENT GAPS between the individual wispy fibres, not a solid brush silhouette. Preserve delicate individual strands. No ground plane, no contact shadow, no opaque background, no text, no logos, no watermark, no wire, plastic, fabric, hair or feathers. Exactly one tuft, not a grid or atlas, no additional objects.
